defaults.composition: Mid-distance view of one water anchor.

shots.subject: A single plunging waterfall about ten meters high falling into a round dark pool, dark-mossed cliff walls and a few overhanging spruce branches
shots.composition: Side view from the pool's edge: the waterfall in the left third, the round pool spreading to the right, spruce branches crossing the top edge and the mossy wall behind.
shots.motion_elements: the falling water and the rippling pool

shots.subject: A mossy boulder island in the middle of a fast river, water parting around it, a weathered log resting against it and yellow alder leaves on the far bank
shots.composition: Level side view from the near bank: the boulder island in the right third, the river parting around it across the frame, the yellow alder bank as a soft band behind.
shots.motion_elements: the water parting around the boulder island

shots.subject: A natural, irregular rock ledge with a broken, uneven lip spanning a river, water pouring over it in several uneven curls of different heights, fresh snow on the boulders of the banks and low warm light on the far trees.
shots.composition: Side view slightly downstream of the ledge: the smooth curl of water running from the left edge to the right third, snowy bank stones in front, the sunlit far bank behind.
shots.motion_elements: the curl of water over the ledge and the foam below it

shots.subject: A clear spring welling from the foot of a dark-mossed limestone outcrop and spilling into a small stream over dark watercress and pale pebbles, dull olive ferns around the outcrop
shots.composition: Side view at knee height: the limestone outcrop and its spring in the left third, the new stream running toward the right edge, the misty fern woodland softly behind.
shots.motion_elements: the welling spring water, the flowing stream and the drifting mist

shots.subject: A river rapid with standing waves over hidden rocks, a gravel bank with small willow shrubs in front
shots.composition: The rapid runs diagonally from the upper left to the lower right corner, the gravel and willow bank along the bottom, a soft forested slope behind.
shots.motion_elements: the standing waves and white water of the rapid

shots.subject: A mountain stream in a clear rocky bed between two wooded banks, its clear grey-green water sliding in one direction down a few low, broken, irregular grey granite ledges, a few burnt copper beech trees standing on the banks
shots.composition: The stream bed runs diagonally from the lower left to the upper right between its two banks, the water sliding over the broken ledges toward the camera, the beech bank along the upper edge
shots.motion_elements: the sliding water over the travertine and the small spills at each step

shots.subject: A flooded side stream tumbling down a steep mossy slope into the main river, wet spruce roots, shining stones and old snow on the bank
shots.composition: The side stream cuts diagonally from the upper right down to the lower left where it meets the main river, the snowy bank and spruce trunks to each side.
shots.motion_elements: the tumbling side stream and the main river current

shots.subject: A river chute pouring through a gap in a long grey granite shelf in summer, rounded boulders and soft spray above the water, deep olive-green alder on the far bank, the sun low and out of frame, soft muted gold light
shots.composition: The granite shelf runs diagonally across the frame with the chute breaking through near the center, boulders in front, the warm far bank behind.
shots.motion_elements: the pouring chute and the hanging spray

shots.subject: A small calm forest pool fed by a short low chute, surrounded by thick green moss and ferns that cover the rocks almost completely, the water clear and slightly tea-brown over round pebbles and a few dull brown leaves, soft even overcast light, natural unprocessed photo
shots.composition: Looking down at about 50 degrees from the edge of a slab: the clear pool filling the middle, the chute entering from the top, the slab edges on both sides.
shots.motion_elements: the inflowing chute, the slow ripples in the pool and the faint tremble of the ferns

shots.subject: A narrow sandstone slot in midsummer where the river squeezes between smooth curved walls of soft muted tan stone, fresh green ferns along the rim and a thin pale mist hanging inside the slot, soft diffuse light
shots.composition: Looking down into the slot from its rim: fern edges at the bottom of the frame, the curved walls dropping on both sides, the river running through the center below.
shots.motion_elements: the squeezed river current and the mist in the slot

shots.subject: A tiered cascade falling over dark slate steps with collars of clear ice on each ledge and snow on the bank stones
shots.composition: Looking down the steps from above at about 45 degrees: the top ledge at the bottom of the frame, the tiers stacking away toward the top, snowy banks on both sides.
shots.motion_elements: the water falling over each tier

shots.subject: A gravel river bar with shallow braided water, snow dusting the stones and low willow shrubs, a calm side channel holding the pale sky
shots.composition: Looking down from a low bluff at about 40 degrees at a section of river bar about thirty meters across that fills the whole frame: the braided channels weaving across it, willow shrubs at the bottom, the calm side channel along the top edge; no mountains, no horizon and no sky except its reflection.
shots.motion_elements: the shallow braided channels

shots.subject: A horsetail waterfall fanning down a granite face about fifteen meters tall, wet dark olive moss on the rock and a soft pale grey sky above the rim, gentle natural contrast like an unedited camera file
shots.composition: Camera at the base looking slightly up: a few wet boulders at the bottom edge, the fan of water filling the middle, the rim and a thin band of soft grey sky at the top; straight vertical lines, no wide-angle distortion.
shots.motion_elements: the fanning waterfall and the splashing pool

shots.subject: A slender waterfall falling beside a wall of dark hexagonal basalt columns, burnt copper rowan trees on the rim
shots.composition: Camera low at the foot of the columns looking up: the columns rising on the left, the slender waterfall in the right third, the rowans and warm sky at the top.
shots.motion_elements: the slender falling water and the trembling rowan leaves

shots.subject: A high waterfall leaping over a rock lip edged with melting snow, its plunge pool rocks below and a gray sky behind
shots.composition: Camera low on the pool rocks looking steeply up: the lip of the fall against the gray sky at the top, the column of water dropping through the center toward the lens.
shots.motion_elements: the leaping water, the spray and the dripping snow edge

shots.subject: A brook spilling down a staircase of mossy rock steps under birch trees with soft pale ochre autumn leaves, natural muted colors and gentle contrast
shots.composition: Camera low in the brook bed looking up the steps: the cascade rising through the frame, the birch canopy and patches of sky at the top.
shots.motion_elements: the cascading brook and the trembling birch leaves

shots.subject: A narrow waterfall falling down a sunlit rock wall, spray at the base and pine boughs near the camera
shots.composition: Seen past soft out-of-focus pine boughs filling the left third, the waterfall sharp in the right two thirds against the warm rock wall.
shots.motion_elements: the falling water, the spray and the swaying pine boughs

shots.subject: A low wide waterfall across a river seen beyond tall tawny grass seed heads on the near bank, mist over the pool
shots.composition: Seen past soft tawny grass seed heads along the bottom and left of the frame, the low curtain of water spanning the middle ground, the misty pool and far bank behind.
shots.motion_elements: the curtain of falling water, the drifting mist and the swaying grass heads

shots.subject: A riverside boulder field in cold first light, blue-gray water rushing between frost-rimmed stones and a pale glow on the far slope
shots.composition: Seen past a large frost-rimmed boulder that fills the lower left, the rushing water between the stones in the middle, the glowing far slope behind.
shots.motion_elements: the rushing water between the stones

shots.subject: A quiet green pool fed by a small snowmelt inflow, a wet dark boulder with remnant snow near the camera and spruce trunks on the far side
shots.composition: Seen past the wet snow-capped boulder in the lower right third, the pool in the middle ground with its small inflow at the left, spruce trunks behind.
shots.motion_elements: the small inflow and the spreading ripples on the pool

shots.subject: A horsetail waterfall on a far dark cliff, fresh snow on the ledges beside it
shots.composition: Long-lens view isolating one stretch of the cliff: the horsetail in the center, snowy ledges framing it, no sky.
shots.motion_elements: the fanning horsetail of water

shots.subject: A milky milky pale grey-green river bursting from under the blue-gray ice of a glacier snout, gray moraine boulders beside it
shots.composition: Long-lens view isolating the snout: the ice face across the top half, the river emerging at the center bottom and flowing toward the lower edge.
shots.motion_elements: the bursting meltwater river

shots.subject: A three-step tiered waterfall on a far forested slope of burnt copper and green autumn trees after rain
shots.composition: Long-lens view isolating the falls in a frame of autumn canopy: the three tiers stacked vertically in the right third, the wet trees filling the rest.
shots.motion_elements: the three falling tiers and the mist rising from the lowest tier

shots.subject: A stretch of river at the bottom of a sunlit red-brown sandstone gorge wall, a few pines on the ledges
shots.composition: Long-lens view isolating one section: the warm gorge wall filling the upper two thirds, the river running across the bottom third.
shots.motion_elements: the river current along the gorge floor

shots.subject: A still pool below a small spill reflecting a dark-mossed cliff and a thin waterfall, round stones along the edge
shots.composition: Symmetrical view across the still pool: the cliff and thin waterfall in the upper half mirrored in the lower half, the spill and stones along the dividing line.
shots.motion_elements: the thin waterfall and the faint ripples on the pool

shots.subject: A slow river bend with calm water mirroring a bank of golden larch trees, mist lifting off the surface
shots.composition: Symmetrical view across the calm bend: the golden larch bank in the upper half mirrored in the water below, mist along the waterline.
shots.motion_elements: the slow current, the soft reflections and the lifting mist

shots.subject: A calm backwater beside a river mirroring a snowy bank of dark spruce, a low waterfall visible upstream
shots.composition: Symmetrical view across the backwater: the snowy spruce bank in the upper half mirrored below, the low waterfall small in the left third.
shots.motion_elements: the low waterfall upstream and the slow ripples on the backwater
